description: This file contains CSS styles for a simple to-do list application, including theming support for light and dark modes, styling for the main app elements, and responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Styles for the main application container including text alignment and background color.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the application logo including size and animation effects.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the application header with flexbox layout and color transitions.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, including color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes.
